key_insight: OrderFlowDiT models the full future limit-order volume field with diffusion, while adding unbalanced optimal transport to better capture both price displacement and total traded volume.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a more realistic way to forecast market microstructure fields, which could improve decision-making systems that depend on spatially distributed supply and uncertainty estimates.
method: Conditional Diffusion Transformer predicts unnormalized bid/ask volume-at-price fields.
Auxiliary unbalanced optimal-transport loss penalizes misplacement in price and mass changes.
New evaluation combines transport cost, proper scoring rules, and calibration diagnostics.
evidence_signal: On 1,950 validation conditions across 30 U.S. equities, adding UOT reduced full-field transport cost by 45.8% and transport energy score by 26.1% versus MSE-only training.
watch_item: The method is tailored to historical order-book data and may be sensitive to market regime shifts, so generalization and real-time deployment should be tested carefully.
paper_title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
